lines.text: This is Raju garu. He loves extra salt. Even when the curry has enough... he adds a little more on top. So what does that salt do inside his body? Let's follow it.
lines.roman: This is Raju garu. He loves extra salt. Pickle, papad, chips. Let's follow that salt.
lines.tts: This is Raju garu. He loves extra salt. Even when the curry has enough... he adds a little more on top. So what does that salt do inside his body? Let's follow it.

lines.text: The salt goes straight into his blood. And here's the twist. Wherever salt goes, water follows.
lines.roman: The salt goes into his blood. And salt pulls water along with it.
lines.tts: The salt goes straight into his blood. And here's the twist. Wherever salt goes, water follows.

lines.text: So now there's more water in his blood. More water in a pipe means more pressure, right? Same inside our blood vessels. That pressure... is blood pressure.
lines.roman: More water in the blood means more push on the walls of his blood tubes. That push is blood pressure.
lines.tts: So now there's more water in his blood. More water in a pipe means more pressure, right? Same inside our blood vessels. That pressure... is blood pressure.

lines.text: First stop... the heart. To push blood against all that pressure, his heart has to pump harder. Every single beat.
lines.roman: First stop, the heart. With more pressure, it has to pump harder, every single beat.
lines.tts: First stop... the heart. To push blood against all that pressure, his heart has to pump harder. Every single beat.

lines.text: Next stop... the kidneys. They try to throw out the extra salt and water. But when more salt keeps coming every day... even they get tired.
lines.roman: Next stop, the kidneys. They try to throw out the extra salt and water. But every day, more salt keeps coming.
lines.tts: Next stop... the kidneys. They try to throw out the extra salt and water. But when more salt keeps coming every day... even they get tired.

lines.text: Year after year... that strong push damages the blood vessels. They turn hard... and narrow.
lines.roman: Year after year, the strong push hurts the tubes. They turn hard and narrow.
lines.tts: Year after year... that strong push damages the blood vessels. They turn hard... and narrow.

lines.text: Last stop... the brain. Here, if a narrow vessel gets blocked or bursts... that's a stroke. The eyes can be damaged too.
lines.roman: Last stop, the brain. A weak, narrow tube here can block or burst. That is a stroke. The eyes can be damaged too.
lines.tts: Last stop... the brain. Here, if a narrow vessel gets blocked or bursts... that's a stroke. The eyes can be damaged too.

lines.text: And Raju garu? Did he feel anything all these years? Nothing. No pain. No warning. That's why it's called... the silent killer.
lines.roman: And Raju garu? He feels perfectly fine. No pain. No warning. That is why it is called the silent killer.
lines.tts: And Raju garu? Did he feel anything all these years? Nothing. No pain. No warning. That's why it's called... the silent killer.

lines.text: One day, he just checks his BP. One fifty... over ninety five. Way too high.
lines.roman: One day, he checks his blood pressure. One fifty over ninety five. Too high.
lines.tts: One day, he just checks his BP. One fifty... over ninety five. Way too high.

lines.text: From that day, his plate changed. Less salt, not more than one small teaspoon a day. More fruits and vegetables.
lines.roman: So he changes his plate. Less salt, not more than one small teaspoon a day. More fruits and vegetables.
lines.tts: From that day, his plate changed. Less salt, not more than one small teaspoon a day. More fruits and vegetables.

lines.text: A thirty minute walk every day. No smoking. No alcohol. And his tablets, exactly as the doctor says.
lines.roman: He walks every day, and stays away from smoking and alcohol. He takes his tablets, just as his doctor says.
lines.tts: A thirty minute walk every day. No smoking. No alcohol. And his tablets, exactly as the doctor says.

lines.text: A few months later... one twenty over eighty!
lines.roman: A few months later. One twenty over eighty.
lines.tts: A few months later... one twenty over eighty!

lines.text: High BP gives no warning. If you're above forty, get your BP checked at least once a year. Silent problem... simple check.
lines.roman: High blood pressure gives no warning. So check yours regularly. Silent problem, simple check.
